recommendation: Keep the source fix. FHIR-40335 remains applied in core, and no further core change is needed unless OO later decides to introduce a separate recorder identity extension or Provenance guidance beyond the published human-transcribed extension.
issue_request: FHIR-40335 was an Applied OO Change Request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R6, asking core Observation notes to clarify where devices belong across Observation.subject, Observation.focus, Observation.device, and the observation-recording extension.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by git commit 65ec458f8b, which added the requested Subject of an Observation guidance to source/observation/observation-notes.xml. The current source still contains the subject, focus, device, and device-search guidance from that application.
additional_context: FHIR-54036 later moved the recorder-related bullet from the Subject section into a new Performer of an Observation section without changing its extension name. FHIR-40384 was later Published in the FHIR Extension Pack with the final extension name and semantics as observation-human-transcribed, making the old observation-recording reference stale in the core text. Observation is active in the current core build via source/fhir.ini, and the Extension Pack source contains the applied observation-human-transcribed StructureDefinition.
reconciliation: Kept the applied FHIR-40335 subject/focus/device guidance and updated the two stale core references to link to the human-transcribed extension. The Performer text now describes what that extension actually records: that an observation value was human-transcribed after being displayed, printed, or otherwise rendered for human consumption.
source_changes: source/observation/observation-notes.xml:17 now links the device-role clarification intro to the Extension Pack human-transcribed extension instead of naming the obsolete observation-recording extension.
source/observation/observation-notes.xml:37 now describes the human-transcribed extension's actual scope and links to StructureDefinition-observation-human-transcribed.html.
